best_idea: Run a cheap per-command filter on every intake, and a costly whole-world invariant check only on sampled frames, while queueing any entity whose state changed by a path that skipped the filter for an end-of-tick sweep that removes disallowed pending actions by tag.
decision_why: Take the filter-plus-sweep shape and the sampled invariant for expensive whole-world checks only. Do not sample the per-command filter, and do not use an unseeded random source on the server; the donor is synced lockstep code where every client must draw the same seed, which a server does not need.
acceptance: A server test: a pending attack queued before a locked state is removed at end of tick and logged to the fight record; a planted illegal command is refused on its first intake; a sampled invariant seeded from the server tick flags a planted inconsistent fighter state within one sample period.
